name: PythonAnywhere

evidence.paas: 03: managed shared Python hosting; the provider runs the web serving and the customer deploys the code
evidence.static: 04: static-only HTML and JS sites are supported

line: Develop and host Python web apps on managed shared infrastructure.

free.text: Beginner free account; web app expires monthly and must be renewed

work.math: $10 a month hosting subtotal, if the conditions apply. Capacity and whether 100 GB is accepted are untested.
$10 is the subtotal for a service that is not directly equivalent. A guaranteed allocation of 1 vCPU and 1 GiB is not available.
A Postgres database can be quoted, but its RAM and the seven-day backup cost are not verified.
